required_inputs: original complex SLC or phase-history product
native-image target coordinates or geographic target region
before_depth_outputs: check adequate spatial and aperture support
freeze target and independent flank coordinates
comparisons: branch A versus correctly gated branch B
independent look geometries in ground coordinates
known surveyed cavities and matched intact regions
evaluation: false alarms per independent scene and area
interpretation_rules: unknown underground conditions are not confirmed negatives
repeatability alone does not exclude stable artifacts
a plausible rendering is not a measured geometry
no depth claim from a metadata/preview-only crop
no field result inferred from synthetic receiver SNR
